name: @repo/perspective-text-3d
description: A PerspectiveText3D text animation component for SmoothUI.

useCases: Hero headlines with depth-stacked lines that tilt on scroll
Pointer-reactive 3D word planes for feature sections
Static tilted title cards for editorial layouts
compositionHints: Pass `container` when the effect should track a scrollable ancestor rather than the window
Keep `depth` modest (24-56px) so separated lines stay legible
